warnings: Axes: x = 1-3 (4.00 each); y = A-D (4.00 each). Origin A1. L-shaped plan: bay 2-3 exists only between rows A and B (plus the floor-2 cantilever to 2''' in bay B-B').
Every line is printed on the S sheets. The roof ridges sit on lines that are printed elsewhere (A''' at 2.00, 1'' at 2.00) — the roof plan itself does not dimension them.
Bay C-D holds the stair: dummy lines C' .. C'''''' come from the S-02 footing chain (1.00/0.50/0.60/1.00/0.90) and the S-03 floor chain (0.35/1.65/1.10/0.90); both end at 11.10.
Architectural sheets were not dimension-swept (op04 time budget for this batch) — z_levels holds only the ground datum printed on the S sheets.
